observable: Scalar cage-composition score: invariant under all rotations and inversion of a 2x2x2 cube.
coordinates: Start with constant, nA, nB, then count unordered AA, AB, BB vertex pairs separated by Hamming distance 1 (edge), 2 (face diagonal), 3 (body diagonal). Each pair counted once; vacancy is the reference. Dot with the coefficients. Species labels 1=A, 2=B. Score sign follows the stored singular vector; simultaneous sign reversal of source and target changes no prediction.
derivation: A cubic-invariant degree-two function is constant on the group orbits of single species sites and colored unordered vertex pairs. The cube group is transitive within each vertex pair Hamming distance. Cold-distribution weighted projection commutes with the group action. Labels on unsupported patterns are extrapolations; this is the score of the pair projection, not a proof an arbitrary tile, finite-state code, or full glass has only pair correlations.
